answers.question: Should local inference run on the homeserver via an Ollama container, or on the DGX Spark via vLLM?
answers.selected_answer: Ollama on homeserver (CPU inference) — already running, GPU upgrade planned. DGX Spark as optional overflow for large batch loads but not always available.

answers.question: Is the wiki hosted as an Obsidian vault on the filesystem or as a Gitea-backed markdown repo?
answers.selected_answer: Gitea as authoritative store, Obsidian as optional local browser via clone.

answers.question: Should vector search use Postgres pgvector (existing) or add Qdrant as a separate Docker container?
answers.selected_answer: Keep pgvector. Monitor 4 signals (query latency >200ms, index build >30min, filter degradation, RAM pressure). Revisit at 500K+ vectors. 10K file ingestion fits easily.

answers.question: Should the knowledge graph use Postgres entity tables (existing) or add Neo4j as a separate Docker container?
answers.selected_answer: Keep Postgres, add typed relationship edges (relationship_type column on entity_relationships). Gets rich relationship types (SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, etc.) without a new container. Revisit Neo4j if graph query complexity demands it.

answers.question: Should embeddings use OpenAI text-embedding-3-large (existing) or switch to local models on DGX Spark?
answers.selected_answer: Keep OpenAI text-embedding-3-large. Cost is negligible (~$2-5/month), no DGX Spark dependency.

answers.question: Which model should be used for the initial batch categorization of 10K OneDrive files?
answers.selected_answer: Qwen 3.5 on DGX Spark for one-time batch (free, fast on GPU), Gemma 4 on homeserver Ollama for ongoing incremental classification.

answers.question: Should model routing use the five-tier hierarchy or the dual-client subscription model?
answers.selected_answer: Three-tier (local Ollama + Haiku + Sonnet) with Anthropic API key, configurable in ai-routing.yaml for future tier additions (DeepSeek, Opus, new providers).

answers.question: What should the monthly LLM budget thresholds be?
answers.selected_answer: Soft $20 / Hard $35. ~30% headroom above $10-18 estimated range.

answers.question: Should the MCP search interface use the existing /mcp endpoint or add qmd?
answers.selected_answer: Keep existing /mcp endpoint only — no qmd. 15 tools already built.

answers.question: Is the primary browse interface the React dashboard or Obsidian?
answers.selected_answer: React dashboard is primary (accessible from any device), Obsidian is power-user tool for graph exploration.

answers.question: Should DeepSeek be included as a tier for entity extraction?
answers.selected_answer: Skip DeepSeek for now, Haiku handles entity extraction. Config ready for future addition. $2.70/month savings not worth the added provider complexity.

answers.question: Should runAgent() support multiple providers or be Anthropic-only?
answers.selected_answer: Make runAgent() provider-agnostic with adapter pattern (~130 LOC). LLMProvider interface with Anthropic + OpenAI adapters. Future-proof for local/alternative providers.

answers.question: Should fallback events be logged silently or generate visible warnings?
answers.selected_answer: Log to ai_audit_log + aggregate in heartbeat. No per-event alerts.

answers.question: ai-routing.yaml shows different models across documents — which is the target state?
answers.selected_answer: Target: Claude models (Haiku + Sonnet). Interim: gpt-5.4 via OpenAI until Anthropic API key obtained.

answers.question: What confidence threshold should wiki pages have?
answers.selected_answer: Use source_count as proxy — no explicit confidence score. Pages with 1 source are tentative; 5+ are well-supported.

answers.question: When a query produces a valuable synthesis, should it automatically be filed as a wiki page?
answers.selected_answer: Both: user-triggered 'Save to Wiki' button for immediate filing + daily wiki-synthesis job reviews unfiled synthesis answers as catch-all. Synthesis answers persisted as captures with type: 'synthesis'.

answers.question: How should the wiki handle the OneDrive file ingestion volume (10K files)?
answers.selected_answer: Qwen 3.5 on DGX Spark for bulk wiki population (domain-by-domain, overnight). Haiku for ongoing daily wiki-ingest. Consistent batch/incremental split.

answers.question: Should wiki pages link back to captures in Postgres?
answers.selected_answer: Bidirectional linking — source_captures UUIDs in wiki YAML frontmatter + wiki_pages tracking on captures in Postgres. Full traceability both directions.

answers.question: Should the wiki use doc1's full directory structure or v2's simplified structure?
answers.selected_answer: Add projects/ and domains/ to current v2 structure. Skip dashboards/ and graph/ (covered by React dashboard and operations/).

answers.question: How should the wiki handle file deletions from OneDrive?
answers.selected_answer: Flag, don't remove. source_removed: true in frontmatter. Wiki-lint evaluates impact. Human decides.

answers.question: How should non-text files (images, spreadsheets, videos) be handled?
answers.selected_answer: Text-bearing formats now + metadata-only for images. Future: multi-modal model on Spark for bulk image processing. Ongoing captures with images processed immediately via vision model.

answers.question: What rclone sync schedule for OneDrive → homeserver?
answers.selected_answer: 15-minute rsync from local OneDrive clone (already mirrored via Docker app on homeserver) to Open Brain corpus. No rclone to OneDrive API needed.

answers.question: Should the Python file extraction pipeline run inside workers or as a separate container?
answers.selected_answer: Separate lightweight Python container for file extraction, BullMQ-triggered via core-api. Same pattern as voice-pipecat.

answers.question: Should the Deepgram spike be a hard gate before Pipecat goes to production?
answers.selected_answer: Soft gate — run full streaming spike before enabling daily use, don't block other work. Existing voice-capture one-shot flow continues.

answers.question: When should legacy voice-capture + faster-whisper be decommissioned?
answers.selected_answer: After 2 weeks of validated Pipecat operation + iOS Shortcut updated with fallback. Then remove 2 containers (10 → 8).

answers.question: Which TTS provider should Pipecat use?
answers.selected_answer: Deepgram cloud TTS. Low cost, low latency, single vendor with STT.

answers.question: voice_sessions.captures_created is INTEGER[] but captures.id is UUID — bug or doc error?
answers.selected_answer: Doc error only — deployed schema is correct (UUID[]). Update PRD text.

answers.question: email_drafts.capture_id is INTEGER but captures.id is UUID — bug or doc error?
answers.selected_answer: Doc error — verify deployed schema matches UUID, update PRD text.

answers.question: Gitea is not listed in architecture tables — should it be?
answers.selected_answer: Add External Dependencies table listing Gitea, Ollama, DGX Spark, Deepgram API, OpenAI API, CF Email Worker.

answers.question: How should the dedup review process work?
answers.selected_answer: Auto-resolve exact dupes (keep newest, log all paths). LLM-assisted triage for near-dupes with confidence scores. Human reviews LLM recommendations.

answers.question: Should the daily sweep cover all brain views or a configurable subset?
answers.selected_answer: All views by default, configurable filter available in notifications.yaml if needed.

answers.question: Should MCP context resource be cached or generated fresh?
answers.selected_answer: 5-minute cache with ?fresh=true bypass option.

answers.question: Should heartbeat check Ollama before it's in the pipeline?
answers.selected_answer: Check Ollama now as informational (not critical). Promote to critical alerting when classification tasks are routed to T0.

answers.question: What should the default autonomy level be?
answers.selected_answer: Move to assist as default. Proactive features are validated — time to receive their notifications.

answers.question: Should Slack auto-response shadow mode monitor DMs or only channels?
answers.selected_answer: Channels + DMs, but DM drafts require higher confidence threshold (0.90+).

answers.question: How long should shadow mode run before enabling DM mode?
answers.selected_answer: Minimum 50 shadow responses reviewed, not time-based. Manual promotion when quality is validated.

answers.question: Should confidence scoring weights be tunable from the dashboard?
answers.selected_answer: Tunable via app_settings API, not dashboard UI initially. Dashboard controls deferred.

answers.question: What per-channel rate limit for threaded auto-responses?
answers.selected_answer: No hard rate limit — confidence threshold is the sole gate. Bot responds whenever confidence criteria are met.

answers.question: Should outbound emails identify as 'Open Brain' or 'Troy Davis'?
answers.selected_answer: Troy Davis as display name, AI disclaimer in signature.

answers.question: Should nodemailer SMTP be migrated to Himalaya?
answers.selected_answer: Migrate all outbound email to Himalaya. Remove nodemailer dependency. Single sending mechanism.

answers.question: Should entity_relationships be extended with relationship_type column?
answers.selected_answer: Add relationship_type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'related_to' to entity_relationships. Minimal migration, backward compatible.

answers.question: Does activity_feed need additional indexes?
answers.selected_answer: Add source_id index now proactively. Enables fast 'show all activity for this capture' queries.

answers.question: How should the three overlapping implementation tracks be sequenced?
answers.selected_answer: v2 stabilization (1 week) → File migration (2-3 weeks) → Phase 7 features. Content first, then intelligence.

answers.question: Should Anthropic API key be a blocking prerequisite?
answers.selected_answer: Non-blocking. Proceed on OpenAI, switch to Claude when Anthropic key obtained.

answers.question: Should file ingestion create captures or use a separate raw_files table?
answers.selected_answer: Use captures table with source: 'file' and rich source_metadata JSONB. Single pipeline for everything.

answers.question: Should multi-model routing include a quality validation suite?
answers.selected_answer: Yes — build 50-example validation suite from existing captures. 90% accuracy threshold for migration.

answers.question: How should config consistency be enforced across documents?
answers.selected_answer: ai-routing.yaml is sole source of truth. Remove hardcoded model references from all other docs.

answers.question: Should OpenTelemetry span attributes be added to BullMQ jobs?
answers.selected_answer: Lightweight OTel spans with trace IDs in logs. No collector infrastructure. Correlate logs across services.

answers.question: How should infrastructure skills access Docker operations from inside a container?
answers.selected_answer: HTTP for health checks, Docker socket mount (read-only) for backup operations. Acceptable risk for homelab, documented.

answers.question: What backup retention policy across all types?
answers.selected_answer: Standardize 7 daily / 4 weekly / 3 monthly across all backup types.

answers.question: Should file ingestion include e2e integration tests with real files?
answers.selected_answer: Yes — 3-5 e2e tests covering major file types (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, CSV). Add to existing e2e-full.sh pattern.

answers.question: Should wiki pages be searchable via the same hybrid search as captures?
answers.selected_answer: Embed wiki pages in pgvector as source: 'wiki' captures. Unified search across all knowledge — raw captures and synthesized wiki pages ranked together.
